book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Woyne Mith Tokkiza Goshsha Asata Leemiso

Qasse isttas leemisora yootishe, «Issaadey ba woyne mith tokkides. Keela yuushshi aaththi keelides; woyne miththa ayfe gum7ana olla bookkides. Naage keeththeka keexxides. Hessafe goshshanchchatas kira immidi hara dere bides.
Miththay ayfiza wode woyne miththaa ayfe ekkada ya giidi ashkaratappe issaade goshshanchchatakko yeddides.
Goshshanchchati ashkaraza oykki shocidi coo mela kushe yeddida.
Nam7anththoka hara ashkara yeddides. Goshshanchchati ha7ikka ashkaraa oykkidi izas hu7etara qoo7idinne kawushshidi zaari yeddida.
Ha7ikka zaaridi hara ashkara yeddides. He yeddoyssaka wodhida; hara darota giddofe issi issi asata qoxxida; baggayta wodhida.
«Ha7ikka kiitettontta attida haray dees; izikka aaway dosiza ba naaza. ‹Ta naaza istti boossana› gi qoppidi wurseththan ba naaza yeddides.
Goshshanchchati qasse ba giddon, ‹Hayssi waanna iza laattana naaza; haa yiite nu iza wodhikko biittay nuus gidana› gida.
Hessa gishshas heen oykki wodhidi woyne miththay dizasoppe haraso kessi yeggida.
«Histtiin woyne miththaa goday ay ooththana inttes misatizee? Izi yaana; goshshanchchatakka wodhana; woyne miththaa haratas immana.
Geeshsha Maxaafan,
Izi isttas leemisoza yootiday istta gishshas gididayssa Ayhuda halaqati erida gishshas iza oykkanaas koyida; gido attiin asaas babbida gishshas aggi bida.
Giira Gishshas Shiiqida Oysho
Yesusa yo7on qaxxana mala Farsaawetappenne Herdoosa baggatappe guuththa asata dooridi izakko yeddida.

Isttika izakko yiidi, «Astamaaree! Neni mooroy baynda as gididayssa nu eroos; ne oonaska babbada wordo maaddaka; Xoossa oge xalala tumu tamaarsaasa. Oroome kawo Qeesaares giira qanxxanaas bessizeyee? Bessennee? Nu qanxxinoyee? Qanxxofinoo?»
Yesusi istta oyshay qoodheppe qommo gididayssa eridi, «Aazas tana qaxxana koyeetii? Ane issi dinaare hammite ta beyays» gides.
Isttika miishshaa ehiin, «Hayssi iza bolla diza mislezi oona mislee? Iza bolla xaafettidayssi oona gizee?» gides. Isttika, «Qeesaareyssa» gida.
Yesusikka, «Qeesaareyssa Qeesaares, Xoossayssa Xoossas immite» gides. Isttika iza zaaron malalettida.
Hayqoppe Denththa Gishshas Shiiqida Oysho
Hessafe guye hayqqidaytas hayqoppe denththi baa giza Saduqaaweti izakko yiidi iza hizgi oychchida.
«Astamaaree! Issi asi machcho ekkidi naa yelontta hayqqiko hayqqidayssa ishay iza machcheyo ekkidi izas laata naa yelana mala kase Musey nuus xaafides.
Gido attiin laappun ishantti deettes; isttafe bayray machcho ekkidi naa yelontta hayqqides.
Kaalozi he maccassayo ekkidi ha7ikka naa yelontta hayqqides; heedzdzanththoyka yelontta hayqqides.
Laappunatikka he maccassayo ekkidi laata yelibeettenna; wurseththan maccassayakka hayqqadus.
Histtiin laappunatikka izo ekkidashin hayqoppe dendoy dizaa gidikko ha maccassaya isttafe oona machcho gidanee?» gida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Intte balettizay Geeshsha Maxaafatanne Xoossa wolqqa erontta gishshassa.
Hayqqidayti dendiza wode Salo Kiitanchchata mala gidana attiin ekettettenanne gelettenna.
Hayqqidayta denththa gishshas gidikko Muse maxaafan hessika qeeri wora giddon eexxiza tama giddofe Xoossi, ‹Tani Abrahaame Xoossaa; Yisaaqa Xoossaa; Yaaqoobe Xoossaa› gizayssa nababibeekketii?
Xoossi paxata Xoossa attiin hayqeththata Xoos gidenna; hessa gishshas intte daro balettideta» gides.
Istti palaman dishin xaafetappe issaadey istta palamaa siyidinne Yesusi oyshettidayssas lo7eththi zaaridayssa akeekidi, «Ero! Azazota ubbaafe aadhdhizay awayssee?» giidi oychchides.
Yesusi izas, «Ubbaafe aadhdhizay hayssa, ‹Isra7eele siya! Godaa nu Xoossi issi Godaa,
Nekka Godaa ne Xoossaa ne kumeththa wozinappe, ne kumeththa shemppofe, ne kumeththa qofappe, ne kumeththa wolqqafe dosa.›
Nam7anththoyka, ‹Ne lagge ne hu7e mala dosa› ha nam7atappe aadhdhiza azazoy baa.»
Xaafezikka, «Astamaaree! Lo7o gadasa, ‹Xoossi issino gididayssanne izappe haray bayndayssa› ne yootidayssi likke.
Iza ne kumeththa wozinappe ne kumeththa qofappe ne kumeththa wolqqafe dosoy qasseka ne lagge ne hu7e mala dosoy xuugettiza yarshofenne hara yarsho ubbaafe aadhdhees» gides.
Yesusikka addezi yuushshi qoppidi zaaridayssa be7idi, «Neni Xoossa Kawoteththafe haahon daakka» gides. Hessafe guye iza oychchanaas xalidaadey beettibeenna.
Yesusi Xoossa Keeththa gaaththan tamaarsishe, «Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti aazas, ‹Kirstoosa Dawite naa› gizoo?
Dawiti Xillo Ayanan haasayshe, ‹Goday ta Godaa, ne morkketa ta ne toho gars aaththana gakkanaas ta ushachchan utta› gides.
Histtiin Dawiti ba doonara iza, ‹Godaa› giikko waanidi simmi izas naa gidanee?» gides. Daro dereykka izi gizayssa ufayssara siyides.
Izi tamaarsishe, «Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytappe naagettite, gadera gooshettiza adussa may7o may7idi yuushshe yuuyana doseettes; awanka aadhdhi aadhdhi asi isttas bonchcho sarota immana mala koyeettes.
Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan dhoqqaso, gibirasonkka bonchchoso koyeettes.
Istti azinay baynda maccassa keeth kalloseettes; qasseka bana bessanaas adussa woosa woosseettes. Haytanti iita pirda pirdettana» gides.
Am7ey Muxuwaata
Yesusikka asay muxuwaata yeggizason uttidi daro asati immizayssa Xoossa Keeththa miishsha shiishshiza saaxinen yeggizayssa xeellides. Daro dureti daro miish yeggida.
Issi azinay baynda am7e dizaara issi sikkinnafe darontta xarqimala biratappe oosettida nam7u miish yeggadus.
Yesusi bana kaallizayta xeygidi, «Ta inttes tumu gays; saaxinezan yeggida ubbaafe hanna manqo am7eya aadheth yeggadus.
Hayti wuri baas diza tirpa miishshaafe yeggidashin hanna qasse ba manqoteththaafe baas dizayssa sinththafe izo koshshizayssara wursa immadus» gides.

footnotes.text: -11 Yochcha shuchchay, tuussi keeththe naagizayssa mala shuchcha keeththi kundontta mala naagizayssa.
